India-EU Free Trade Agreement Expected to be Signed by Year-End

India's Free Trade Agreement (FTA) with the European Union (EU) is anticipated to be signed before the end of the year, with the agreement potentially becoming operational within four to five months after signing. Union Minister Piyush Goyal stated this timeline and urged businesses to prepare for the operationalization of the FTA.
